title: Cobbliki REI
description: A client-side REI (Roughly Enough Items) integration for Cobblemon. It turns the REI panel into a Pokédex of game data.
body:
# Cobbliki REI

A client-side [REI](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei) integration for [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) that turns the recipe panel into a Pokédex.

Press **R** (recipe) on a Pokémon, move, item or coin to see how to get it, or **U** (uses) to see what it does. Cobbliki REI fills in the drops, moves, evolutions, spawns, stats and prices for you.

Everything is read from the content you actually have installed: your mods, datapacks and configs. Nothing is hardcoded, so if a datapack changes Charizard's drops or adds a new region's trainers, the panel just reflects it. It's fully bilingual (English and Spanish), and it's form-aware everywhere, so Alolan, Galarian, Hisuian, Mega and other forms each show their own data.

## Features

Each one is a normal REI category. Use **R** on a Pokémon or item to see how to obtain it, and **U** to see what it's used for.

### Pokédex (press R on a Pokémon)

A multi-page entry for every species and every form:

* Live 3D model of the exact form
* Base stats, height and weight, catch rate, base XP, friendship, gender ratio and egg groups
* Types, with a hover tooltip showing the full defensive matchup for that type combo (weaknesses, resistances and immunities)
* Abilities with their in-game effect text (the hidden ability is labelled)
* Riding stats: style (air, land or water), seats, speed, acceleration, jump, stamina and skill
* Where to find it: biomes, structures, rarity, level range and conditions like time, weather and light, so you can finally figure out where that legendary actually spawns

### Combat and breeding

* **Defeat Drops**: what a Pokémon drops when beaten, with chance and quantity
* **Pasture Loot**: passive drops from a pastured Pokémon (needs Cobblemon Pasture Loot)
* **TM Compatibility**: a Pokémon's learnable TM, Tutor and Egg moves with type, power, accuracy and PP, per form
* **Compatible Pokémon**: press U on a move or a tmcraft disc to see everything that learns it
* **Move Details**: a move's full data sheet

### Evolution and forms

* **Evolution** and **Evolution Item**: how a Pokémon evolves (level, friendship, trade, held items like the Dubious Disk or Metal Coat, Link Cable, or special form items) and what it evolves from and into, form-aware
* **Mega Evolution**: Mega Stone to species to Mega form, including X/Y and special combinations (needs Cobblemon: Mega Showdown)
* **Fossil / Resurrection**: fossils to revived Pokémon, including datapack legendaries

### Economy and trainers

* **Buy / Sell**: the full CobbleDollars shop plus merchant inventories (gems, stones, evo items, vitamins, balls and more) with real prices (needs CobbleDollars)
* **Trainer Drops**: press R on a gym badge or reward to see which trainer drops it, shown as the 3D trainer NPC (needs Radical Cobblemon Trainers)

Every Pokémon and move is also a searchable REI entry with its live 3D model or type icon.

## Dependencies

**Required**

* Minecraft 1.21.1 and [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/)
* [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
* [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)
* [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) 1.7.x
* [Roughly Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei) 16.x

**Optional** (a category shows up only when its mod is installed)

* [CobbleDollars](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobbledollars) for Buy and Sell
* [tmcraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/tmcraft) for TM discs
* [Cobblemon: Mega Showdown](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-mega-showdown) for Mega Evolution
* [Cobblemon Pasture Loot](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-pasture-loot) for Pasture Loot
* [Radical Cobblemon Trainers](https://modrinth.com/mod/rctmod) for Trainer Drops

## Client-side only

Cobbliki REI runs entirely on the client and reads client-synced registries, mod jars, datapacks and configs. In singleplayer or LAN everything is available. On a remote server, anything the server never syncs to clients may not show up.

## Credits

The CobbleDollar coin icon is derived from the [CobbleDollars](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobbledollars) mod by Harmex, and all rights to that art stay with its author. Used with credit. Pokémon models, type icons, ability text and species data are Cobblemon's, rendered through its own client API.
